context: Today, to let one session use Opus you either approve each spawn, type an override that lifts every guard, or set a repo grant that needs a fresh session. The proposal: a second pass word, such as 'opus 2h' or 'opus builders 2h', that lifts only the Opus cap for this session and its subagents until it expires.

options.gain: Opus when you want it, with every other guard still on.
options.how: A lane adds it to the one override-pass home.
options.label: Yes, build the pass word
No, keep the three ways
options.lose: Getting Opus stays clumsy or too broad.

ref: c41 (Opus for one session or one run, without lifting other guards)
title: Add an Opus-only pass word, such as 'opus 2h'
why: It closes the gap between 'ask each time' and 'lift everything'.
